dataset_name: COVID-19 CT scan lesion segmentation dataset
reason_for_no_strict_lung_constraint: The estimated lung masks are not sufficiently reliable in QC; therefore, CASR-Net will use scribbles and teacher confidence without strict anatomical masking.

recommended_training.teacher: fully supervised UNet++ EfficientNet-B0 using full lesion masks
recommended_training.student: CASR-Net using sparse scribbles and teacher confidence
